title: Team Fortress 2
notes: highball-db: plays with DXMT; VAC runs in user mode.
Verified in GamePort (2026-10-30): Apple M1 MacBook Air, macOS 27.0.1, engine x64-crossover26.3-hb20261014. Main menu and gameplay worked through Steam -applaunch.
TF2 uses Direct3D 9: the 'dxmt' renderer runs D3D9 through DXVK-Kegworks d9vk (Vulkan → MoltenVK → Metal); DXMT itself is for D3D10/11 only.
